judgment_text:
PRAYER :- Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India to issue Writ of Mandamus or any other appropriate writ or direction, directing the respondent No. 3 and 4 herein to forbear the respondent No. 6 from celebrating and bringing Deity Box in the eve of Mahasivarathiri scheduled on 15.02.2026 in connection with the Maha Sivarathiri festial in our patta land in S. No. 85/7A (patta No. 223), Sithalai Village, Thirumangalam, Madurai District by considering the petitioner's representation dated 23.01.2026.

PRAYER :- Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India To issue a Writ of Mandamus by directing the respondents to award adequate police protection for our celebration to be taken place on 15.02.2026 in connection with the Maha Sivarathiri Festival in our patta land in Survey no. 85/7A (Patta No. 223), Sithalai Village, Thirumangalam, Madurai District by considering the petitioner's representation dated 23.01.2026.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

S. Srimathy, J.:— WP (CRL.) (MD) No. 842 of 2026 has been filed for issuance of a Writ of Mandamus directing respondents 3 and 4 to forbear the 6th respondent from celebrating and bringing the Deity Box on the eve of Maha Sivarathiri scheduled on 15.02.2026, in connection with the Maha Sivarathiri festival in the petitioner's patta land bearing S. No. 85/7A (Patta No. 223), situated at Sithalai Village, Thirumangalam, Madurai District, by considering the petitioner's representation dated 23.01.2026.

WP (CRL.) (MD) No. 854 of 2026 has been filed seeking a direction to the respondents to provide adequate police protection for the celebration to be conducted on 15.02.2026 in connection with the Maha Sivarathiri Festival in the petitioner's patta land in Survey No. 85/7A (Patta No. 223), Sithalai Village, Thirumangalam, Madurai District, based on the petitioner's representation dated 23.01.2026.

2. Admittedly, there are five villagers, who are five Pangalis. A fit person has also been appointed by the HR & CE Department. In spite of the same, the dispute among the parties has not been resolved. Therefore, after deliberation, this Court is of the view that allotting specific time slots to each Pangali would sufficiently resolve the dispute for the present occasion.

3. Accordingly, on 15.02.2026, between 6.00 a.m. and 8.00 p.m., each Pangali shall be allotted two hours to conduct the celebration in an orderly manner. The respondent Police are directed to provide adequate police protection to ensure implementation of the above arrangement and to maintain law and order.

4. With the above directions, these Writ Petitions are disposed of.
